steps.text: A charity, a school or a club raises money by asking people to give what they can. This video shows how the Fundraising module runs a campaign on your site: donors choose their amount, the page shows how close you are to the goal, and every donor gets a receipt for their taxes.

chapters.title: Why a fundraising campaign
chapters.subtitle: Give what you choose, and see the goal

steps.text: A shop sells things at a fixed price. A donation is different: each donor decides how much to give, and many want to give in honor or in memory of someone.
Donors like to see that their gift matters, so a campaign needs a goal, and progress toward it, where they give.
And a donor who gives to a charity needs a receipt for their taxes, with the organization's name and tax number.
The Fundraising module covers all three, on top of the same cart and checkout as the rest of your store.

chapters.title: How it is organized
chapters.subtitle: Receipts, a campaign, and the donors

steps.text: You set who donations go to, and what receipts say, once, under Settings.
A campaign is a product with the Fundraising campaign part: a goal, suggested amounts, a least donation, an end date, and whether gifts get a tax receipt.
Donors give from the campaign's page, and check out like any order. Discounts and promotion codes never take anything off a donation.
Each donor is emailed a receipt, and finds it under Donations in their account.
Open Settings, Commerce, Fundraising. Organization is who donations go to, as it reads on receipts. Leave it empty to use the site's name.
Tax ID is your tax or charity registration number, printed on receipts.
Receipt statement is what the receipt says about the gift, such as that nothing was given in return for it.
Email donors their receipts is on by default. Untick it to have donors find their receipts in their account only. Click Save.
A campaign is a product whose content type has the Fundraising campaign part. Open the list of campaigns under Content, Content Items, and edit the campaign.
Goal is what the campaign raises toward, in the product's currency. Leave it empty for no goal.
Suggested amounts are offered as buttons, separated by commas, such as twenty five, fifty, one hundred. Donors can also enter their own, and Least donation sets the smallest gift.
Ends says when the campaign stops taking donations. Leave it empty for no end.
Tick Donations get a tax receipt when gifts are tax deductible. The product's price is hidden on the page, since donors choose the amount.
On the campaign's page, the progress shows what has been raised toward the goal, how many have given, and the days left.
Donors click a suggested amount, or enter their own. Amounts show in the donor's currency.
They can name someone they are giving in honor or in memory of. That name is kept on the order, and shown on the receipt.
They click Add to cart, and check out like any order, with whichever payment methods you offer. Once a campaign ends, it stops taking donations.
Every donation is an order. Open Commerce, Orders to see them like any other.
Open one. The line says Donation with its amount, and In honor of shows the name the donor gave.
Only paid donations count toward the campaign's progress. When you refund a donation's order, the refund comes off the progress, and shows on the donor's receipt.
A donor who is signed in finds Donations in their account: each gift with its date, who it honors, its amount and its receipt number.
Click Receipt to open it. It shows your organization, your tax ID and your statement, and the donor can print it.
The same receipt is emailed to the donor when Email donors their receipts is on.

chapters.title: Use cases
chapters.subtitle: How organizations put it to work

steps.text: A library or a school fundraiser: one campaign with a goal and a closing date.
A charity with a standing appeal: a campaign without a goal or an end date, always open.
A memorial fund: donors give in memory of someone, and the name is kept on each receipt.
Year-end giving: every donor gets a tax receipt, by email and in their account.
With the Fundraising module, a campaign takes gifts of any size, shows its progress, and gives every donor a receipt. Thanks for watching.
